exposure: 5 ml of ethiodized poppyseed oil bathing
outcome: H-score of expression of anb-3 in endometrium
cohort: The study included infertile women with recurrent implantation failure (RIF) who had undergone three or more transfer cycles, cumulative transplantation of at least four high-quality cleavage-stage embryos or three high-quality blastocysts without clinical pregnancy, and still had high-quality frozen embryos available.
finding: Oil-soluble contrast medium bathing significantly decreased CD138-positive cells and upregulated expression of anb-3 during the window of implantation, as well as increased endometrial thickness, which may enhance fertility in patients with recurrent implantation failure undergoing frozen-thawed embryo transfer.
